exposure: Maternal perineum damage during vaginal delivery
cohort: 451 full-term singleton fetuses with breech presentation and 526 full-term singleton fetuses with cephalic presentation
finding: In the high altitude region of the Tibetan Plateau, vaginal delivery for full-term breech presentation fetuses in the lithotomy position was associated with higher risks compared to cephalic presentation fetuses, but timely identification of dystocia or fetal distress and conversion to cesarean section significantly improved safety.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was less safe than cesarean delivery for breech presentation fetuses in the Tibetan Plateau.
